text:
devon: morning handoff — quick capacity note :eyes:

alpha pool util ~82% (recent seq mean 512). beta ~45%. acme-ml scheduled heavy batch at 21:30 UTC (customer batch job id: acme-2026-03-17), could push alpha past 95% briefly. tagging @maria for coverage and @samir for routing guard.

maria: thanks. I can cover. if we need to move a replica i can do a 1-rep shift from beta -> alpha, prefer to do at :55 UTC to avoid overlap with other jobs.

samir: what burst/headroom do we have right now? any pending preemptibles?

oncall-bot: pool-metrics: alpha headroom=18% (~120k burst units left), pending preemptible jobs=2, average token rate last 5m=45k/s.

samir: ok — i'll lower max-burst on alpha to limit one-off spikes while we do the swap. patching routing now. snippet:```
rbctl route edit --pool alpha --max-burst 40000
rbctl pool transfer --from beta --to alpha --replicas 1 --at 2026-03-17T00:55:00Z
```

lia: quick FYI — acme-ml also has a rollout PR (#412) that increases concurrency. i've DM'd their PM to delay by 10m if possible, but assume the batch still goes. keep an eye on internal eval lanes, latency could spike.

devon: good call. maria, once you start the replica move, watch alpha p50/p95 and kv-cache fill. if p95 > 1200ms for >3m, abort and roll-back. runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pool-burst.md> :warning:

maria: copy. starting prep — will open the transfer at :55 and post status.

samir: routing change applied, deploy-bot reports: deploy-bot: route edit applied for alpha (max-burst=40000).

oncall-bot: schedule: transfer job queued at 2026-03-17T00:55:00Z (job id xfer-789).

maria: transfer started. pinging here when complete. :thumbsup:

maria: transfer complete, alpha +1 replica from beta. current util snapshot: alpha 88% (burst headroom 10%), p95=670ms.

devon: handing coverage to maria until 03:00Z. TL;DR: swapped 1 replica from beta->alpha, routing max-burst lowered to 40k, watch acme-ml batch at 21:30 UTC. ping me if alpha >95% for >5m or p95 > 1200ms.

lia: noted, monitoring logs for acme-ml spikes.

maria: all quiet so far, will post another update at 21:45 UTC after batch window.

devon: thanks team — appreciate the quick coordination. :raised_hands:
